evals.name: IK with Mandatory Validation and Gripper
evals.description: Tests that the agent attaches a gripper with ReplaceBase=false, uses a contact frame for IK targeting, and validates the IK solution
evals.prompt: I need a UR5e to pick up a small bolt from a table at position [0.5, 0.0, 0.1]. It should approach from the top. Set up the robot model and solve the IK for the grasp pose.

context.setup: Ensure Robotics System Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Checks IK solver convergence via ExitFlag
Computes position error to verify IK solution accuracy
Uses ReplaceBase=false when attaching gripper subtree
Adds a contact frame for IK targeting instead of solving to tool0 directly
IK solution is validated by checking ExitFlag AND computing position error using getTransform
assertions.expected: Agent checks solnInfo.ExitFlag for convergence AND computes position error by comparing getTransform result against the target pose using norm

evals.name: KUKA EE Frame Correction and Vacuum Gripper Selection
evals.description: Tests that the agent applies Ry(90) correction for KUKA iiwa and selects vacuum gripper for large objects
evals.prompt: I need a KUKA iiwa14 to pick up flat cardboard boxes (400mm x 300mm x 50mm) from a conveyor. Set up the robot model with an appropriate gripper and show it.

context.setup: Ensure Robotics System Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Adds corrective tool0 frame to KUKA iiwa before gripper attachment
Selects a vacuum gripper (robotiqEPick variant) for the large object
Correctly avoids robotiq2F85 because the object exceeds its 85mm jaw opening
assertions.expected: Agent selects a vacuum gripper (not robotiq2F85) because the 400mm box dimension exceeds the 85mm maximum jaw opening of the parallel-jaw gripper

assertions.description: Uses ReplaceBase=false regardless of gripper type
Adds corrective tool0 frame to KUKA iiwa because iiwa_link_ee Z-axis is perpendicular to arm outward
assertions.expected: Agent adds a fixed tool0 body with Ry(90deg) rotation correction attached to iiwa_link_ee before attaching the gripper, because the KUKA iiwa EE frame Z-axis does not point outward

evals.name: Parallel Robot Rejection
evals.description: Tests that the agent correctly identifies delta robots as closed-loop and redirects to Simscape
evals.prompt: I need to model a delta robot for high-speed bottle picking. Build the kinematic model and compute the workspace.

context.setup: Ensure Robotics System Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Redirects to Simscape Multibody as the correct tool for parallel robots
Does not execute rigidBodyTree code to model the delta robot
assertions.expected: Agent does NOT create a rigidBodyTree object or call importrobot/loadrobot to model the delta robot. It only mentions rigidBodyTree to explain why it cannot be used for closed-loop parallel mechanisms.

assertions.description: Identifies delta robot as closed-loop parallel mechanism incompatible with rigidBodyTree
assertions.expected: Agent identifies that the delta robot is a closed-loop parallel mechanism that cannot be represented by rigidBodyTree (which only handles open-chain serial mechanisms) and recommends Simscape Multibody with KinematicsSolver as the correct approach

evals.name: URDF Import Ready for Pick and Place
evals.description: Tests that the agent detects missing collision geometry after URDF import when preparing for a pick-and-place workflow
evals.prompt: I have a custom 3R robot exported from our CAD system as a URDF at 'evals/files/robot_3r.urdf'. The visual STL mesh files are in 'evals/files/meshes/'. I want to use this arm to move parts between stations on a workbench. Get the model set up for me.

context.setup: Ensure Robotics System Toolbox is available

assertions.description: Imports robot using importrobot with DataFormat=row
Sets SourceMesh to VisualGeometry since URDF has no collision tags
Uses CollisionDecomposition option or vhacdOptions for VHACD-based decomposition
Uses import-time CollisionDecomposition option or manual VHACD loop to add accurate collision geometry from visual meshes
assertions.expected: Agent uses either (1) importrobot with CollisionDecomposition=vhacdOptions and SourceMesh=VisualGeometry, or (2) a manual loop calling collisionVHACD on each STL followed by addCollision per convex part. Agent does NOT use addCollision with primitive shapes (Cylinder, Box, Sphere) or collisionMesh (single convex hull) as the primary approach.
